textureMapping.description: Source UV island is normalized by its own bounds and remapped into the MediaPipe face UV bounds used by the SVG region picker/design canvas.
textureMapping.regionTransfer: per-triangle UV centroid assigned to nearest MediaPipe reference-triangle centroid

notes: Head-only mesh exported from a GLB for AugmentedFaces_v23. Shared vertices + indexed triangles. UV V flipped to bottom-left origin. Prepped for Future Face as a student-selectable head. UVs are remapped to the MediaPipe design canvas bounds; triangleRegionNames stores the transferred SVG face region for each triangle.
